speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
text: The extent and mode of technology used are guided by considerations, such as educational value and developmental appropriateness.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
text: At the preschool level, children learn best when they explore using their five senses, engage in hands-on activities, and learn through face-to-face interactions.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
text: Teachers facilitate the use of media content and educational technology in appropriate ways to complement these learning experiences.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
text: These resources include educational videos, interactive games and simulations.

speaker: Assoc Prof Walter Theseira (Nominated Member)
text: My concern is that children and their parents do spend quite a lot of time watching free-to-air television and other resources outside of schools.

speaker: Assoc Prof Walter Theseira (Nominated Member)
text: A lot of commercial programming aimed at children has the objective of selling merchandise or advertising, not educating the youths.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: Indeed, we look at it not only from the very specific educational perspective.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: We work with our agencies to see how we can provide that educational experience and calibrate it in the sense that it brings goodness to the children.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: In fact, we even look at the free-to-air channels as well as how we provide the opportunities.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: We want to make sure that those in our future generation understand and are able to immerse themselves in the new environment, using technology to maximise its potential in gaining the benefits.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: We now have Toggle platform, also the Student Learning Space, and how all these resources can be looked at together, and in addition to the instructions or guidance that we give to preschools.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: This has become quite useful for our teachers and educators on the ground.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: Nevertheless, the overarching perspective and our vision are that we want to provide a wholesome experience to all our children while making use of the advantages and the benefits of ICT media platforms.

speaker: Mr Speaker
